panels.title: NVIDIA FY2026 Export Control Risk Summary
panels.program:
root = Card([header, excerpt, explanation], null)
header = CardHeader("Export Control Risk - NVIDIA FY2026 Report", "Item 1A. Risk Factors section, partial extract")
excerpt = TextContent("The U.S. government announced export restrictions and licensing requirements since August 2022 targeting semiconductor and supercomputing industries in China, Russia, and other regions. These impact specific NVIDIA products such as the A100 and H100 integrated circuits, and imposed burdensome licensing conditions that may limit business opportunities and encourage customers to consider alternative suppliers.", "default")
explanation = TextContent("In simple terms, U.S. export controls restrict NVIDIA's ability to sell certain high-performance chips and related technology to some countries. This can lead to lost sales, more complex licensing steps, and competition from other chip makers not subject to these restrictions.", "default")

// Source: NVIDIA 10-K Fiscal 2026, pages 9-11 (partial section)
